lines.text: One teaspoon of this star weighs billions of tons.
And it spins faster than your blender.
It's a neutron star: the crushed core of a dead giant star.
It packs more mass than our whole Sun into a ball about the size of a city.
That makes it as dense as the nucleus of an atom. One teaspoon would weigh more than three billion tons.
lines.caption: That makes it as dense as the nucleus of an atom. One teaspoon would weigh more than 3 billion tons.

lines.text: And the fastest one we know spins seven hundred and sixteen times every second. About twice as fast as a kitchen blender.
lines.caption: And the fastest one we know spins 716 times every second. About twice as fast as a kitchen blender.
